completion_proof.description: Optional evidence-backed closure of this finite boundary; inspected alone is not complete.

account_labels.description: Original observed account cells. For CSV, only the jurisdiction-specific fiscal_code_style declaration may split a prefix; prefix2 separates exactly two code digits and preserves all remaining name digits.

account_label.description: Account name after explicitly declared source code/name separation; ambiguous raw code identities do not match an edition automatically.

content_confirmation.description: Required by the completion gate for an expenditure edition, not for candidate registration; indices refer to content_inspection.evidence.

content_grain.description: Optional observed grain for this exact account/year/phase edition. It overrides the document-level grain only for this edition; other accounts remain independently checked.

published_grain_exception.description: Optional whole-original printed-absence proof; never confirms project×setsu and never waives search, approval, scope or output checks.

publisher_revision.description: Optional publisher revision evidence; page-update dates, inspection dates and filenames are not revision dates.

primary_fiscal_page.description: Whether this publisher listing is the primary fiscal page for equivalent editions; omission retains the existing heading-based preference.

observed_levels.description: Observed source terms; provided project paths are checked with canonical dbt levels jikou, saimoku, jigyo, daijigyo, chujigyo, shojigyo, rather than romanization aliases.

content_grain.description: Observed levels and relation evidence are necessary for completion. Independent Chiyoda moku/setsu side inputs are checked directly against adopted original/table/provenance hashes and their dedicated provided CSV, with same-edition explanation_dataset_id; they never certify a project×setsu correspondence.

fixed_inputs.description: Adopted input snapshot may include statement-moku-setsu/ independent side tables; their own IDs and original grain are checked directly rather than requiring int_fiscal_lines membership.

unresolved_resolutions.description: One explicit resolution per exact unresolved item, with current lock/origin/output identities; never a blanket waiver.

complementary_source_ids.description: Other originals required alongside this split volume; reciprocal references within the same fiscal scope. A single part cannot be selected as the complete canonical statement.

target.description: Declared processing target, independent of observed source identity.
